About The Program

Parivartan Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS) Programme 2026-27 is a scholarship initiative by HDFC Bank through its CSR programme, Parivartan. The programme is built on a simple but powerful conviction: a student's financial circumstances or personal hardships should never be the reason they discontinue school or college. The opportunity is open to school students from Classes 1 to 12, as well as those pursuing diploma, ITI, polytechnic, UG, and PG (both general and professional) courses. The programme aims to provide financial assistance of up to INR 75,000 to meritorious students with limited financial means. Preference will be given to those who have faced a personal or family crisis that may affect their ability to continue their education.

Parivartan has been a catalyst for community-level transformation through focused interventions in rural development, education, skill development, livelihood enhancement, healthcare, hygiene promotion, and financial literacy. Through the ECSS initiative, this commitment reaches students directly, helping ensure that personal or family crises do not disrupt their academic journey.

Parivartan ECSS Programme for School Students (Merit-cum-Need Based) 2026-27
Eligibility
Deadline Date: 31-Oct-2026
The applicant must be currently enrolled in Classes 1 to 12, or pursuing a diploma, ITI, or polytechnic course at a private, government, or government-aided institution in India.
A minimum of 55% marks in the most recent qualifying examination is required.
The annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.
Open to Indian nationals only.
Preference will be given to applicants who have experienced a personal or family crisis in the past three years that has significantly impaired their ability to bear the cost of education and placed them at risk of dropping out.

Note: For diploma applicants, only students who have enrolled after completing Class 12 are eligible to apply.

Read more..

Benefits:

Selected students will receive benefits as mentioned below:

For Classes 1 to 6: INR 15,000
For Classes 7 to 12, Diploma, ITI, and Polytechnic: INR 18,000

Parivartan ECSS Programme for Undergraduate Students (Merit-cum-Need Based) 2026-27
Eligibility
Deadline Date: 31-Oct-2026
The applicant must be currently enrolled in a full-time graduation programme at a recognised college or university in India, covering general courses such as B.Com., B.Sc., B.A., etc., and professional courses such as B.Tech., MBBS, LLB, B.Arch., and Nursing.
A minimum of 55% marks in the most recent qualifying examination is required.
The annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.
Open to Indian nationals only.

Note: Preference will be given to applicants who have faced a personal or family crisis in the past three years that has significantly affected their ability to continue their education.

Read more..

Benefits:

Selected students will receive benefits as mentioned below:

For General UG courses: INR 30,000
For Professional UG courses (B.Tech., MBBS, LLB, B.Arch., Nursing, etc.): INR 50,000

Parivartan ECSS Programme for Postgraduate Students (Merit-cum-Need Based) 2026-27
Eligibility
Deadline Date: 31-Oct-2026
The applicant must be currently enrolled in a postgraduate programme at a recognised college or university in India, covering general courses such as M.Com., M.A., etc., and professional courses such as M.Tech. and MBA.
A minimum of 55% marks in the most recent qualifying examination is required.
The annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.
Open to Indian nationals only.

Note: Preference will be given to applicants who have faced a personal or family crisis in the past three years that has significantly affected their ability to continue their education.

Read more..

Benefits:

Selected students will receive benefits as mentioned below:

For General PG courses: INR 35,000
For Professional PG courses: INR 75,000
